analysis.reasonEn: RSI attempts to exit oversold (42.7→43.0), but MACD histogram remains worsening (-0.2900 holding) with weak trend reversal signals. Volume ratio at 0.65 of 5-day average indicates subdued activity and low confidence. Four consecutive daily closes in the red show a persistent downtrend, with the current price ($86.96) nearing the lower Bollinger Band ($86.98). The price is 31.9% below its 52-week high and 53.6% above its 52-week low. ADX at 10.4 signifies a non-trending environment, suggesting potential for shock-like moves.
